resolution: ROOT CAUSE symptom→ the served pool composer's family did not grow across successive composes; mechanism→ the /pool/compose route created fresh members each POST and passed NO priorCompositions, so every compose was a family of 1 (the ratchet lived only in the module); origin→ Phase 3 built Pool.composeAndAdjudicate's priorCompositions path + the Phase-3 driver exercised it, but the served route was not wired to accumulate the session's edit lineage (the exact reachability gap this sprint's completeness law exists to kill). FIX (smallest-change): serve-studio holds a per-session poolCompositions history; each /pool/compose passes it as priorCompositions and accumulates the new composition; a successive compose is a genuine EDIT (a swapped member set via the variant) so the family RATCHETS. RE-TEST: two served composes now give family 1→2 (three give 1→2→3); the ratchet is reachable through the UI; the verdict differential stays byte-identical (the frozen core untouched).
